messages.author: c3cde982f551021c
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] MPredictor == ny
parts:
like this
"spde <- inla.spde2.matern(mesh=mesh,alpha=2)
hyper=spde$f$hyper.default
field.indices = inla.spde.make.index("field", mesh$n, n.group=length(table(data$date)))
predictor2<-c("date","loc_id")
A.est = inla.spde.make.A(mesh,loc=as.matrix(coords), group=data$date)
stack.est = inla.stack(data = list(validate=log(data[,validate]+1)),
                      A = list(A.est,1),
                      effects = list(c(field.indices, list(Intercept=1)),
                                     list(data[predictor2])),
                      tag="est")
stack <- inla.stack(stack.est)
dim(inla.stack.A(stack))
formula <-validate~-1+Intercept+f(loc_id,model='iid')+ date +
  f(field,model=spde,hyper=hyper,group=field.group, control.group = list(model='ar1'))
result <- inla(formula,
               data=inla.stack.data(stack,spde=spde),
               family="gaussian",
               control.compute =list(dic =T, cpo =TRUE,waic = T),
               control.predictor =list(compute = TRUE, A = inla.stack.A(stack)),
               verbose = T)"
